description: Turn a written incident briefing script into one incident brief voice clip per labeled cue. This incident brief voice studio records each accident notice audio and safety brief read from the script the office already wrote, then delivers 8 to 20 incident brief voice pack files. Use it for incident brief clip packs that keep one brief line on each clip.
